name: Abyss Palm
description: Strike with a palm heavy as deep water so the weight of the dark below presses into the target.

name: Abyss Ward
description: Wrap the forearms in dense deep water qi that swallows the force of a blow and keeps none of it.

name: Abyss Glide
description: Sink into the stance and come up two paces away as if drawn along a deep current.

name: Abyss Pull
description: Drag the opponent forward by the ankles with a pull of deep qi and strike the stumbling chest.

name: Pressure Mend
description: Press steady water qi into an ally's crushed ribs until the bone settles and the bruising fades.

name: Sinking Weight
description: Add the weight of deep water to a strike so the target's qi and legs sink under it.

name: Abyss Crush
description: Close two columns of deep water qi on the target so the pressure crushes the guard and the frame behind it.

name: Dark Water Veil
description: Hold a veil of lightless water qi round the body that swallows sight and breaks the aim of attackers.

name: Abyssal Pressure
description: Lay the full pressure of the deep on one point of the body so it fails from within past any guard.

name: Brine Palm
description: Strike with a palm coated in salt-heavy water qi that stings and numbs where it lands.

name: Brine Ward
description: Catch an attack on a brine-slick forearm and let it skid away along the salt film.

name: Brine Step
description: Slide forward over the ground on a slick of heavy salt water qi that grips the foot only when wanted.

name: Brine Wash
description: Rinse an ally's open wound in salt-heavy water qi that cleans it hard and knits it shut.

name: Brine Bite
description: Rake salt-laden fingers over a cut so the sting breaks the opponent's guard and rhythm.

name: Salt Wash
description: Draw out a creeping poison or rot from an ally's wound with a long wash of salt-heavy qi.

name: Brine Veil
description: Hang a veil of brine over the body that corrodes the edge of any weapon that cuts through it.

name: Brine Lash
description: Whip a heavy lash of brine across the target so the blow tears flesh and leaves the wound burning.

name: Salt Mantle
description: Wear a crusted mantle of salt water qi that blunts blows and drags at the qi of anyone who touches it.

name: Salt Seal
description: Crust the target's chief qi path with brine so the qi stops flowing there for a long span.

name: Fathom Palm
description: Drive a palm into the target with water qi stacked behind it as if a fathom deep.

name: Fathom Guard
description: Stack layers of water qi before the chest so each layer takes a share of the blow.

name: Fathom Step
description: Take a long gauged step in which the qi under the sole measures and keeps the distance.

name: Fathom Sense
description: Sound the depth of an opponent's reserve with a probing pulse of water qi and read how deep it runs.

name: Fathom Press
description: Press the weight of a full fathom on the opponent so the strike lands and the legs buckle.

name: Fathom Mend
description: Lay layered water qi over an ally's deep gash and let each layer close a little more.

name: Fathom Crash
description: Drop the whole stacked weight of the fathom through a single fist onto the target.

name: Fathom Pull
description: Hook the opponent in a heavy pull of qi and haul the body in to meet the waiting strike.

name: Deep Absorb
description: Take a heavy strike into a body of deep water qi and hold the swallowed force as stored reserve.

name: Maelstrom Palm
description: Strike with a spinning palm that winds the target's clothing and balance into the turn.

name: Gyre Guard
description: Spin a small gyre of qi at the guard hand so strikes are drawn round and away.

name: Whirl Stride
description: Turn on the rear foot in a wide gyre that carries the body behind the opponent.

name: Whirling Mend
description: Turn a slow gyre of healing qi round an ally's torn side until the flesh is drawn together.

name: Gyre Pull
description: Set a gyre spinning at the opponent's waist to wrench the stance and strike the turning back.

name: Maelstrom Veil
description: Keep a whirl of qi round the body that tears at each strike and spins its force away.

name: Gyre Wash
description: Spin a slow gyre round an ally that draws taint and curse residue out and away from the body.

name: Maelstrom Fist
description: Wind a maelstrom up the arm and punch so the target is ground by the spinning force on contact.

name: Grinding Maelstrom
description: Spin the surrounding qi field into a great maelstrom that drags and grinds every nearby opponent.

name: Maelstrom Reversal
description: Turn a gyre against a heavy strike so the whole force swings back around the user into the sender.

name: Surf Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries the break of a wave through the target's guard.

name: Surf Ward
description: Let a breaking line of qi rise before the body so a strike breaks on it instead.

name: Surf Glide
description: Glide forward on the leading face of a wave of qi with the knees bent and the weight low.

name: Surf Break
description: Break a heavy wave of qi on the opponent so the strike lands and the stance is thrown apart.

name: Foamcrest
description: Ride a strike up a foaming crest and cut down on the attacker from above.

name: Surf Balm
description: Wash cooling surf-like qi over an ally's burns and sprains until the swelling falls.

name: Surf Crash
description: Dive through breaking surf and bring the whole weight of the wave down on the target.

name: Surf Wave
description: Throw a rolling line of surf outward that bowls over every opponent it meets.

name: Surf Flash
description: Burst into spray and reform beyond the opponent's reach before the sound of the wave arrives.

name: Confluent Palm
description: Strike with a palm into which two streams of water qi have been joined before the blow.

name: Confluent Ward
description: Join two films of qi from the left and the right hand into one thick guard.

name: Confluent Step
description: Pass through two quick strides that join into one long glide on the merged current of qi.

name: Merging Mend
description: Merge two thin streams of healing water qi into one at the wound so the flesh closes faster.

name: Merging Current
description: Join two currents round the opponent's arm into one binding rope and strike past the held guard.

name: Joined Wash
description: Wash a poisoned ally with two joined flows that carry the venom out and rebuild the blood.

name: Confluent Veil
description: Draw two veils of qi from the two hands together so that the guard thickens wherever it is struck.

name: Confluent Crash
description: Meet two heavy streams of water qi in the target and let them burst against each other there.

name: Joined Torrent
description: Pour two torrents across the field until they join and sweep every opponent between them.

name: Confluence Revival
description: Join two great streams of water qi over a fallen ally whose breath has just stopped to restart heart and lungs.

name: Spate Palm
description: Loose a sudden spate of water qi through an open palm at a sworn word.

name: Spate Ward
description: Raise a quick wall of rushing water qi to take a strike and fall away afterwards.

name: Spate Step
description: Leap the distance on a sudden swell of qi and land with the weight already settled.

name: Spate Lash
description: Lash a narrow spate of qi along the sworn bearing into the opponent's exposed side.

name: Sworn Draught
description: Share a sworn draught of water qi with an ally to lift strength and renew the reserve.

name: Spate Hold
description: Hold a standing spate before the body that shoves back each strike that touches it.

name: Spate Fall
description: Drop a heavy spate onto the opponent so the strike lands and the qi sinks under the weight.

name: Spate Surge
description: Send a spate across the open ground at a sworn word and sweep the opponents off their feet.

name: Dissolving Step
description: Dissolve into flowing water qi to pass through a body or a barrier and re-form on the far side.

name: Riptide Palm
description: Strike with a palm and pull the qi back sharply so the target is dragged forward onto the blow.

name: Riptide Guard
description: Turn an attacker's limb along a hidden pull and leave the body off the held bearing.

name: Riptide Step
description: Let a sideways pull of qi carry the body across the attacker's line in one smooth step.

name: Slackwater Mend
description: Still the qi round an ally's wound to calm water and let it heal without further tearing.

name: Riptide Pull
description: Set a hidden pull on the opponent's legs that drags the footing along the held bearing.

name: Riptide Cut
description: Cut across the pull with a stiff edge of qi so the strike lands and the drag spins the foe.

name: Slack Wash
description: Draw an ally's blood through a slow clean eddy to leave poison and fatigue behind.

name: Riptide Drag
description: Drag the opponent along a strong pull across the ground and strike at the end of the drag.

name: Riptide Break
description: Break a heavy attack against the hidden pull and strike back along the same drag.

name: Riptide Seal
description: Pin a foe's qi paths with a locked pull so the opponent cannot gather or move qi for a span.

name: Undercurrent Palm
description: Strike with a palm that looks idle while a hidden current drives the force under the guard.

name: Undercurrent Guard
description: Hold a plain stance and let a hidden current turn aside each blow before it lands.

name: Undercurrent Step
description: Move without any visible wind-up on a hidden current to arrive at the foe's shoulder.

name: Hidden Pull
description: Pull the opponent's lead foot with a hidden current and strike as the weight comes forward.

name: Quiet Cleanse
description: Pass a hidden clean current through an ally to carry off taint without a sign on the surface.

name: Hidden Current
description: Loose a thin current of qi along the ground that rises under the opponent's guard.

name: Undercurrent Surge
description: Raise the hidden current into a sudden surge that strikes through the guard from below.

name: Undercurrent Lock
description: Hold the foe's qi down with a hidden current that locks the legs and slows the breath.

name: Undercurrent Siphon
description: Draw the opponent's qi off in a hidden current before a single blow is thrown.

name: Drift Palm
description: Strike with a palm that arrives like blown spray and lands with a sharp wet slap.

name: Spray Guard
description: Let the guard hand drift with a strike and carry its force wide on the wind-torn spray.

name: Drift Step
description: Drift sideways in the open on a veil of spray and arrive at the flank without cover.

name: Drift Mend
description: Fling a mist of healing spray over several wounded allies in the open so the wounds begin to close.

name: Drift Lash
description: Whip a stinging lash of wind-torn spray across the eyes and face of the foe.

name: Blown Veil
description: Hold a veil of spray out on the wind that scatters thrown missiles and softens close blows.

name: Spray Sense
description: Let a drifting cloud of spray touch every body on the open ground and report where each stands.

name: Spindrift Volley
description: Hurl a hail of hard-edged spray in a wide volley that stings and cuts at long range.

name: Spindrift Cloak
description: Wrap the body in a cloak of whirling spray that blunts strikes and carries the wearer along.

name: Spindrift Flash
description: Burst into scattering spray and re-form in the open a long way off before the spray settles.

name: Downpour Palm
description: Strike with a palm that hammers down like a sudden downpour onto the target's shoulder.

name: Downpour Guard
description: Pour a hard curtain of rain-like qi in front of the body to beat a strike aside.

name: Downpour Step
description: Plunge forward under cover of falling water qi so the opponent's eyes lose the body.

name: Drench
description: Drench the opponent in heavy water qi so the strike lands and the qi grows sodden and slow.

name: Downpour Wash
description: Call a downpour over wounded allies to scour poison and filth from every wound at once.

name: Soaking Mend
description: Soak an ally to the skin in healing rain that mends cuts and bruises together.

name: Downpour Fist
description: Hammer the target with a fist that carries the whole weight of a downpour in one blow.

name: Pounding Downpour
description: Hold a field of hammering rain over the open ground so every opponent in it is beaten and soaked.

name: Hammering Downpour
description: Condense a downpour into a hail of needle-fine streams that pierce armour and guard together.

name: Aquifer Palm
description: Drive water qi up from the deep reserve below the stance and out through the palm.

name: Aquifer Ward
description: Draw a layer of stored water qi up round the body to meet a strike.

name: Aquifer Step
description: Spring from the stance on a rising draw of stored qi and cross a pace and a half.

name: Aquifer Mend
description: Share a slow draw from the deep store with a wounded ally to close the wound without strain.

name: Aquifer Draw
description: Open the store of qi below the stance and let nearby allies drink from it to refill their reserves.

name: Aquifer Sense
description: Read every seam and cache of water in the ground and walls to find hidden rooms and hiding foes.

name: Aquifer Veil
description: Draw stored qi up as a standing veil that thickens each time a strike lands on it.

name: Aquifer Burst
description: Burst the whole stored reserve upward through the fist in one blow that lifts the target off the ground.

name: Aquifer Flood
description: Flood the ground round the user with water qi drawn from below until the opponents lose their footing.

name: Reservoir Heart
description: Open the full reservoir of deep water qi to restore strength and wounds to all the allies beside the user.
